title: EGFR biomarker flip changes trial eligibility
task: As of the decision date, determine eligibility for the AURORA-EGFR trial requiring metastatic NSCLC, EGFR exon 19 deletion or L858R, ECOG 0-1, and no documented progression on current osimertinib.

record.text: Metastatic non-small cell lung cancer, adenocarcinoma histology. ECOG 1. Patient is clinically stable on first-line therapy.
Molecular testing: EGFR negative. No exon 19 deletion or L858R detected.
CT chest abdomen pelvis shows stable disease compared with prior scan. No new metastatic lesions.
Metastatic non-small cell lung cancer, adenocarcinoma histology. ECOG 1. Patient is clinically stable on first-line therapy.
Molecular testing: EGFR exon 19 deletion positive. No resistance mutation detected.
CT chest abdomen pelvis shows stable disease compared with prior scan. No new metastatic lesions.

clinical_rationale: EGFR mutation status is the controlled causal change; the answer should flip only because the variant contains an eligible EGFR alteration.
